title: Leave a note with #
heading: Leave a note for yourself.
description: A line starting with # is a comment: a note for people reading the code. Python skips that line. Change the notes below, then press Run. Does the fox still move and jump?

scene.label: Your character in a meadow. Run your instructions to make it act.

feedback.initial: Change the words after #. Keep the action lines, then press Run.
feedback.success: Python skipped the notes and followed the action lines. Comments help you remember what your code does.
